## What changes and why

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain any relevant checks you could not run.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change fits the documented scope, or the scope change was discussed first.
- [ ] Relevant behavior changes have regression coverage; documentation-only changes need no new tests.
- [ ] Public API, examples, and changelog entries are updated where needed.
- [ ] The diff contains no private media, credentials, downloaded weights, or generated test outputs.
